title: Normalized direct-image coefficient-restriction comparison
statement: For the coefficient systems of [def-coef-semilinear-system-models] and the algebraic inverse images I_n of [lem-coef-ordinary-inverse-system], suppose the adjacent coefficient squares commute. Let uInv preserve finite limits and admit right adjoint uPush. Suppose each I_n.modules has right adjoint V_n, and supplied isomorphisms eV_n identify the underlying sheaf of V_n(N) with uPush of the underlying sheaf of N, compatibly with the supplied Hom adjunction as in [lem-coef-normalized-module-adjunction]. For every n ≤ m there is a natural isomorphism res(F_m → F_n) ⋙ V_m ≅ V_n ⋙ res(B_m → B_n), whose underlying map composed with eV_n is eV_m of the scalar-restricted object.

source.place: Tag 03D7, direct images of modules and the normalized transpose, applied to coefficient restriction.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03D7: the right-adjoint restriction map is the transpose of the restricted counit.

proof.text: Iterate the adjacent ring square by forming the natural transformation of the ring sequences. Use the existing inverse-image scalar-restriction comparison at every n ≤ m.

Compose the forward inverse-image comparison at V_n(N) with the restricted counit, then transpose at m. The normalized Hom equations and naturality identify its underlying map with eV_n followed by the inverse of eV_m. Underlying sheaves reflect isomorphisms, so the transposed map is invertible. Its inverse gives the required restriction comparison. Its underlying normalization and faithfulness prove naturality, and hence the natural isomorphism.

theorem directRestrictions_exists [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (hI : ∀ n,
      uInv.map ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{max c v r})).map (τ n)) ≫
          (I n).ringUnderlying.hom =
        (I (n + 1)).ringUnderlying.hom ≫
          (sheafCompose J' (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{max c v r})).map (σ n))
    (uPush : Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)))
    (adjSet : uInv ⊣ uPush)
    (eV : ∀ n, V n ⋙ underlying.{c, v, r} J (B n) ≅
      underlying.{c, v, r} J' (F n) ⋙ uPush)
    (ha : ∀ n (M : Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J (B n))
      (N : Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J' (F n)) (f : (I n).modules.obj M ⟶ N),
      (underlying.{c, v, r} J (B n)).map ((a n).homEquiv M N f) ≫ (eV n).hom.app N =
        adjSet.homEquiv _ _ ((I n).moduleUnderlying.inv.app M ≫
          (underlying.{c, v, r} J' (F n)).map f)) :
    Nonempty (DirectRestrictions.{c, v, r} J B τ J' F σ V uPush eV)
